name: Nature Documentary
description: Narrated slowly, over footage of something waiting

ja.description: 何かが待っている映像に、静かな語り

verbs: One by one, they return home
The older one watches, and waits
This is the only chance it gets
It will not eat again for days
The colony has its own logic
A thousand of them. One survives
And so the cycle begins again
Life, it seems, finds a way
